관한설명으로옳지않은것은?
①Where a ship, without lawful excuse, deviates from the voyage contemplated by
the policy, the insurer is discharged from liability as from the time of deviation.
②It is immaterial that the ship may not in fact have left the course of voyage
contemplated by the policy when the loss occurs.
③There is a deviation from the voyage contemplated by the policy where the
course of the voyage is not specifically designated by the policy, but the
usual and customary course is departed from.

excused where caused by the barratrous conduct of the master or crew, if
barratry be one of the perils insured against.
⑤When the cause excusing the deviation or delay ceases to operate, the ship
must resume her course, and prosecute her voyage, with reasonable dispatch.
